spotlights.headline: BIG SPORTS SATURDAY!
spotlights.note: First reusable Family Spotlight. Both children qualify from their exact calendar occurrences, never from season flags — the 2026-27 swim757 window in sports-config.json is stale and swim757Active is false on this date, which is deliberately irrelevant here. expireAt is 5:00 PM ET: the Ophelia event runs 12:30-4:30 PM (team picture, intrasquad meet, then the Kick-Off Party), and the full event participates, so expiry is 30 minutes after the latest participating end.

detail.note: Authored literal. The 12:30 team picture and 1:00 intrasquad meet exist only as prose inside one 12:30-4:30 PM calendar event, so there is nothing structured to derive. The literal is anchored to the data by match.startsAt: if the event moves, the child fails closed rather than showing a stale time.

Joined to data/sharks-soccer.json on the stable matchNumber, never on athletics.sharksNextGame — that pointer advances as soon as the match is marked played and would invalidate this child mid-treatment. opponentLabel and venueLabel are display shortenings and are honoured only while they remain truthful substrings of the authoritative row values.
